question: During the Green Revolution period in India, child nutrition-focused scheme, the Integrated Child Development Scheme (ICDS) was launched in________
solution:
The correct answer is the __**1975**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme launched **on 2 October 1975, by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.**
 
• The** Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme** represents one of the world’s largest and unique programs for early childhood care and development.
 
• It is the foremost symbol of the country’s commitment to its children and nursing mothers. 
 
• The beneficiaries under the Scheme are children in the age group of 0-6 years, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Objectives of ICDS
 
 
• **To enhance children’s nutritional and health status between the ages of 0 and 6 years.**
 
• **To create the groundwork for the child’s healthy psychological, physical, and social growth.**
 
• **To minimize the occurrence of death, morbidity, malnutrition, and school dropout.**
 
• **To create excellent policy and execution coordination among the various departments in order to enhance child development.**
 
• **To improve the mother’s capacity to care for her child’s normal health and nutritional needs via correct nutrition and health education**
